messages:
maya_ml: Heads up — pepper9b-int4 canary rolled at 07:05 and after ~1h were seeing sporadic OOMs (~2.7%) correlated with long sessions and multibatch traffic.
maya_ml: Flame graphs point to slot fragmentation + slab alloc jitter, not a steady leak.
tony_runtime: Can you paste the error snippet and the canary config?
maya_ml: Logs:
```
OOM: alloc failed 180MB at handle seq=3289
trace: allocator::alloc -> slab::split -> kv_manager::attach_slot
```
maya_ml: Current canary config:
```
{ "batch_size": 2, "max_new_tokens_default": 300, "prefetch_slots": 5, "slot_slab_size_kb": 64 }
```
tony_runtime: Hypothesis: small slab size + batch_size>1 creates lots of partial slot allocations -> fragmentation. int4 reduces tensor bytes but increases slot churn. Quick low-risk changes: bump slab size, set batch_size=1 for canary, enable slab coalescing, reduce max_new_tokens, add soft reserve.
harper_infra: Proposed patch: slab_size_kb=256, batch_size=1, max_new_tokens_default=120, slab_coalesce=true, soft_reserve_mb=150.
zach_sre: Also add safety rule: if OOM rate >1% over 15m, auto-route to pepper9b-fp16 fallback and page on any coredumps.
maya_ml: I ran a small A/B with the patch on 6 nodes for 2h. Results:
- OOM rate: 2.7% -> 0.18%
- p95 latency: +18ms
- cost/token: ~-4.2%
- quality: tiny regression on long-dialog QA (increase in hallucination cases ~0.06% of eval) -> ticket ML-4289
tony_runtime: Tradeoffs look acceptable. Plan to enable per-route overrides for long-generation routes that need higher max_new_tokens.
harper_infra: Operational rollout plan:
1) update canary model config to:
```
{ "batch_size": "1", "max_new_tokens_default": "120", "prefetch_slots": "3", "slot_slab_size_kb": "256", "slab_coalesce": "true", "soft_reserve_mb": "150" }
```
2) observe for 3h, watch oom_rate, fragmentation_ratio, p95, and run the long-dialog QA + summarization evals
3) if oom_rate < 1% and no eval regressions -> promote to 25% traffic and monitor 6h
4) rollback instantly if coredumps > 0 or oom_rate spikes
harper_infra: I'll create the rollout job and wire the rollback rule now.
deploy-bot: Canary patch for pepper9b-int4 deployed at 2026-04-02T07:54:00Z. Observability hooks added: fragmentation_ratio, oom_rate, p95_latency.
zach_sre: Add an alert: fragmentation_ratio > 0.7 for 10m -> page SRE.
maya_ml: Filed doc task ML-4290 to capture per-model slab defaults, experiment notes, and per-route override guide.
tony_runtime: Follow-up idea: implement adaptive slab sizing that grows slab_size on-the-fly for slabs with high-churn session patterns. Tech-debt ticket incoming.
maya_ml: Thanks everyone. Will paste the rollout link here once job is live :)
